FormChanges.title: Form-Changing Abilities

menu.name: Form-Changing Abilities
menu.label: Edit List
menu.hint: The abilities Transmutation Focus counts as a creature changing its form. Size changes from effects always count.

FormChanges.intro: Transmutation Focus gives focus when you or a creature within 10 squares changes its form. These are the abilities that count, matched by name. Add your own for homebrew.
FormChanges.name: Ability name

modeHint.self: the creature using the ability changes, as with Bat Form.
modeHint.effect: a creature changes when the ability's effect is applied to it, so a resisted Petrify does not count.
modeHint.targets: each creature it targets changes, or the user when it targets nobody, as with Abyssal Evolution.
